summary.zh: 本次更新聚焦网络体验：加密 DNS 支持自选服务商，下载加速镜像改为内置预设并支持真实测速。
summary.en: This update focuses on networking: the encrypted DNS resolver is now provider-selectable, and download accelerator mirrors come as presets with a real speed test.

items.zh: 设置新增“加密 DNS（DoH）”：可在内置服务商（国内优先）中自选解析端点，重启应用后生效
items.en: New Encrypted DNS (DoH) setting: pick a built-in resolver endpoint (CN-friendly providers first), applied after restart

items.zh: 下载加速镜像改为内置预设一键选择，并支持真实下载测速（不再是手动输入前缀）
items.en: Download accelerator mirrors are now one-tap presets with a real download speed test (replaces manual prefix input)

items.zh: 测速通过每个镜像实际下载样本数据并展示吞吐速度，直接连接选项一键关闭加速
items.en: Speed test downloads a sample through each mirror and shows throughput; a direct-connection option disables acceleration

items.zh: DoH 解析器端点真正接入网络层：保存的选择现在会在重启后实际生效
items.en: The chosen DoH endpoint is now actually wired into the network stack and takes effect after restart
